text.p: These are the leading stories in Skopje press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified them nor does it vouch for their accuracy.

- New incident on Macedonian-Albanian border occured in the night between May 19 and 20. One Finish peacemaker was wounded in a gun fight some 150 metres away from the UNPREDEP monitoring post. Macedonian authoriteis claim that Albanian caravan of cigarette smugglers tried to enter Macedonia.

- The investigations on legality of the publich purchases in the ministry of internal affairs is to be clarified soon. some 600 million German marks were spent for armoured transporters, police uniforms, different equipment, works of art, police horse riding squad etc.
- IMRO-DPNMY intends to have one hour anti-government protests all over Macedonia while the Liberal democrats will continue with the pressure in the parliament for debate on early elections.
- Some $30 million is needed to end construction of the dam Kozjak which began three years ago. The water regime between Macedonia and Greece still not regulated.

- Prime Minister Branko Crvenkoski and leader of the ethnic Albanian party PDPA Arben Djaferi discussed the possible models of electoral laws in the country. PDPA urges early elections by the year end.
- The initiative for two opposition ethnic Albanian parties in Macedonia PDPA and NDP to unite into the Democratic party of Albanians to be discussed by their leadership.
